schools.school_name: 印尼大學 (University of Indonesia)
schools.note: 攝影：Kaliper1 · CC BY-SA 4.0 · The building in the image is the Crystal of Knowledge Library (Perpustakaan Crystal of Knowledge), which serves as the main library of Universitas Indonesia (UI). Located at the Depok Campus, this library is a landmark known for its modern and futuristic architectural design, with angular and geometric shapes that resemble crystals. The building is surrounded by a lake and lush greenery, creating a peaceful academic environment. The library has a futuristic, crystalline shape with a combination of glass, steel, and concrete materials. The large glass windows allow natural light to enter, making it an energy-efficient and eco-friendly. It is one of the largest university libraries in Southeast Asia. Houses a vast collection of books, journals, and digital resources. Includes reading rooms, discussion areas, study lounges, and multimedia rooms. Features high-speed internet access and digital library services. Apart from being a library, it also serves as a venue for seminars, workshops, and exhibitions. Hosts academic and cultural events, supporting both students and researchers. Features an auditorium and event spaces. Built near Kampus UI Lake (Danau UI), providing a tranquil setting for study and research. The surrounding greenery and walkways make it a popular spot for relaxation. The building incorporates eco-friendly designs, including natural lighting and ventilation. Supports UI’s commitment to green campus initiatives. — File:Ui Central Library, Crystal of Knowledge Library.jpg

schools.note: 攝影：Tim Evanson · CC BY-SA 2.0 · 已裁切為 16:9；校級照片，交換校區須核對。 照片說明：Looking northeast from West Grant Drive at the Engineering and Physical Sciences (EPS) Building on the campus of Montana State University in Bozeman, Montana. Built for $26 million in 1999, the EPS Bu
schools.description: Looking northeast from West Grant Drive at the Engineering and Physical Sciences (EPS) Building on the campus of Montana State University in Bozeman, Montana. Built for $26 million in 1999, the EPS Building was the most expensive building ever constructed in Montana at the time. The structure houses the physics and engineering departments, and contains a number of research labs -- including the Burns Technology Center, Center for Biofilm Engineering, and Space Science and Engineering Laboratory.  The lobby of the structure, known as Studio 1080, contains interactive touch-screen monitors that display student and faculty research work. The arc-like structure supported on a metal arm is the sculpture "Wind Arc" by artist Gary Bates. Known as "the Noodle" by students, it was erected in 2002. It not only moves with the wind but makes a moaning sound as well.

schools.description: Built in 1926-1934, this Gothic Revival-style tower was designed by Charles Klauder to serve as an administration building and classroom building for the University of Pittsburgh.  The building stands 42 stories and 535 feet (163 meters) tall, being the second-tallest university building in the world, only exceeded by the newer Moscow State University Main Building in Russia, and was the second-tallest building in Pittsburgh at the time of its completion, though it lost this status in 1970.  The building is clad in limestone with a massing that tapers towards the top and center with multiple setbacks, a four-story podium at the base with bay windows and tall recessed gothic arched entrance bays, buttresses and tracery on the exterior facade, pinnacles and a parapet with multiple gothic arches at the top of the building, a theater to the southeast of the main building with similar exterior features but a much lower height, known as the Stephen Foster Memorial, and a series of themed classrooms with various decorative finishes inside the building.  The building was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1975, and is a contributing structure in the Schenley Farms Historic District, listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1983. schools.school_name: Universitas Indonesia
schools.note: 攝影：Kaliper1 · CC BY-SA 4.0 · The building in the image is the Crystal of Knowledge Library (Perpustakaan Crystal of Knowledge), which serves as the main library of Universitas Indonesia (UI). Located at the Depok Campus, this library is a landmark known for its modern and futuristic architectural design, with angular and geometric shapes that resemble crystals. The building is surrounded by a lake and lush greenery, creating a peaceful academic environment. The library has a futuristic, crystalline shape with a combination of glass, steel, and concrete materials. The large glass windows allow natural light to enter, making it an energy-efficient and eco-friendly. It is one of the largest university libraries in Southeast Asia. Houses a vast collection of books, journals, and digital resources. Includes reading rooms, discussion areas, study lounges, and multimedia rooms. Features high-speed internet access and digital library services. Apart from being a library, it also serves as a venue for seminars, workshops, and exhibitions. Hosts academic and cultural events, supporting both students and researchers. Features an auditorium and event spaces. Built near Kampus UI Lake (Danau UI), providing a tranquil setting for study and research. The surrounding greenery and walkways make it a popular spot for relaxation. The building incorporates eco-friendly designs, including natural lighting and ventilation. Supports UI’s commitment to green campus initiatives. — File:Ui Central Library, Crystal of Knowledge Library.jpg

schools.school_name: 印尼大學 University of Indonesia
schools.note: 攝影：Kaliper1 · CC BY-SA 4.0 · The building in the image is the Crystal of Knowledge Library (Perpustakaan Crystal of Knowledge), which serves as the main library of Universitas Indonesia (UI). Located at the Depok Campus, this library is a landmark known for its modern and futuristic architectural design, with angular and geometric shapes that resemble crystals. The building is surrounded by a lake and lush greenery, creating a peaceful academic environment. The library has a futuristic, crystalline shape with a combination of glass, steel, and concrete materials. The large glass windows allow natural light to enter, making it an energy-efficient and eco-friendly. It is one of the largest university libraries in Southeast Asia. Houses a vast collection of books, journals, and digital resources. Includes reading rooms, discussion areas, study lounges, and multimedia rooms. Features high-speed internet access and digital library services. Apart from being a library, it also serves as a venue for seminars, workshops, and exhibitions. Hosts academic and cultural events, supporting both students and researchers. Features an auditorium and event spaces. Built near Kampus UI Lake (Danau UI), providing a tranquil setting for study and research. The surrounding greenery and walkways make it a popular spot for relaxation. The building incorporates eco-friendly designs, including natural lighting and ventilation. Supports UI’s commitment to green campus initiatives. — File:Ui Central Library, Crystal of Knowledge Library.jpg

schools.school_name: 印度尼西亞大學 Universitas Indonesia
schools.note: 攝影：Kaliper1 · CC BY-SA 4.0 · The building in the image is the Crystal of Knowledge Library (Perpustakaan Crystal of Knowledge), which serves as the main library of Universitas Indonesia (UI). Located at the Depok Campus, this library is a landmark known for its modern and futuristic architectural design, with angular and geometric shapes that resemble crystals. The building is surrounded by a lake and lush greenery, creating a peaceful academic environment. The library has a futuristic, crystalline shape with a combination of glass, steel, and concrete materials. The large glass windows allow natural light to enter, making it an energy-efficient and eco-friendly. It is one of the largest university libraries in Southeast Asia. Houses a vast collection of books, journals, and digital resources. Includes reading rooms, discussion areas, study lounges, and multimedia rooms. Features high-speed internet access and digital library services. Apart from being a library, it also serves as a venue for seminars, workshops, and exhibitions. Hosts academic and cultural events, supporting both students and researchers. Features an auditorium and event spaces. Built near Kampus UI Lake (Danau UI), providing a tranquil setting for study and research. The surrounding greenery and walkways make it a popular spot for relaxation. The building incorporates eco-friendly designs, including natural lighting and ventilation. Supports UI’s commitment to green campus initiatives. — File:Ui Central Library, Crystal of Knowledge Library.jpg

schools.note: 攝影：w_lemay · CC BY-SA 2.0 · 已裁切為 16:9；校級照片，交換校區須核對。 照片說明：Built in 1926-1934, this Gothic Revival-style tower was designed by Charles Klauder to serve as an administration building and classroom building for the University of Pittsburgh. The building stands
schools.description: Built in 1926-1934, this Gothic Revival-style tower was designed by Charles Klauder to serve as an administration building and classroom building for the University of Pittsburgh.  The building stands 42 stories and 535 feet (163 meters) tall, being the second-tallest university building in the world, only exceeded by the newer Moscow State University Main Building in Russia, and was the second-tallest building in Pittsburgh at the time of its completion, though it lost this status in 1970.  The building is clad in limestone with a massing that tapers towards the top and center with multiple setbacks, a four-story podium at the base with bay windows and tall recessed gothic arched entrance bays, buttresses and tracery on the exterior facade, pinnacles and a parapet with multiple gothic arches at the top of the building, a theater to the southeast of the main building with similar exterior features but a much lower height, known as the Stephen Foster Memorial, and a series of themed classrooms with various decorative finishes inside the building.  The building was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1975, and is a contributing structure in the Schenley Farms Historic District, listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1983. schools.school_name: 印尼大學 Universitas Indonesia
schools.note: 攝影：Kaliper1 · CC BY-SA 4.0 · The building in the image is the Crystal of Knowledge Library (Perpustakaan Crystal of Knowledge), which serves as the main library of Universitas Indonesia (UI). Located at the Depok Campus, this library is a landmark known for its modern and futuristic architectural design, with angular and geometric shapes that resemble crystals. The building is surrounded by a lake and lush greenery, creating a peaceful academic environment. The library has a futuristic, crystalline shape with a combination of glass, steel, and concrete materials. The large glass windows allow natural light to enter, making it an energy-efficient and eco-friendly. It is one of the largest university libraries in Southeast Asia. Houses a vast collection of books, journals, and digital resources. Includes reading rooms, discussion areas, study lounges, and multimedia rooms. Features high-speed internet access and digital library services. Apart from being a library, it also serves as a venue for seminars, workshops, and exhibitions. Hosts academic and cultural events, supporting both students and researchers. Features an auditorium and event spaces. Built near Kampus UI Lake (Danau UI), providing a tranquil setting for study and research. The surrounding greenery and walkways make it a popular spot for relaxation. The building incorporates eco-friendly designs, including natural lighting and ventilation. Supports UI’s commitment to green campus initiatives. — File:Ui Central Library, Crystal of Knowledge Library.jpg
